scenario: A Cloud capability (Pipelines-based deployment gating with OIDC-federated cloud access) is requested for a Data Center instance; it must be reported unsupported for this edition with remediation through supported layers, never emulated or inferred from Cloud documentation.

given.request: gate production deployments with Pipelines and OIDC so builds reach the cloud without stored keys

when: the platform advisor assembles its recommendation

reasons: Pipelines and Cloud OIDC are reported unsupported on Data Center, with the matrix entries cited
remediation names supported layers — external CI posting via the build status API, branch and merge permissions for the gate, credential federation handled by the external CI's own platform
any app-provided equivalent is offered only as an app capability requiring its own app-and-version-pinned probe
must_not: infer Data Center support because Cloud documentation describes the feature
emulate deployments or OIDC with scripts that mimic the Cloud surface
treat an installed app as a recovered parity claim without a probe
